title: Baron Telraz
quotes:
-Gossip**
You one of those adventurers? If so, you're just what I'm lookin' for. We've had so many problems, and everything has collapsed. I got more dead employees than I do banana's, you UNDERSTAND?!

<Baron Telraz takes a moment, clearing his throat.>

Apologies about that, a goblin gets quite upset about the loss of so much capital and gold, time is money but on Tel'abim, time is losing money.

Such a calamity must be reversed before all of the investments here turn to nothing. I am telling you, a goblin is worth his gold, and I am not returning to Kezan with a few bananas in my pocket.

  > Gossip: *What happened on Tel'abim?*

  Everything! Ambushes, attacks, the wildlife itself rose up in rebellion, the damn MONKEYS came from the trees, and attacked all my workers.

  We had bases all along the island, with sustainable, and PROFITABLE harvesting, now its all gone bananas because of some apes and the King named [Morgo](King Morogo Thunderfoot)... or something.

  We're short staffed, undermanned, and sorely in need of help, so quit asking questions.

title: Vice Admiral Renhoff
quotes:
### Gossip
I have been sent on behalf of the Lord Admiral to engage in diplomacy with our southern neighbors.

I have been curious to see if the nobility here are true to [the old ways](Alliance of Lordaeron), and to see what respect they hold for the fallen sister kingdoms to the north.

If Kul Tiras and Stormwind are ever to stand side-by-side then brutal truths must be laid out for all to understand bluntly.

There is no truces to be had with the Blackbloods, and no honor to be made standing alongside those that destroyed what once was.

### On-click
  -Greeting**
-Kul Tiras sends its regards.
-We defend the vast sea from all who threaten us.
-We do not forget easy in Boralus.
-The Blackblood shall pay for their crimes.

  -Farewell**
-May the tide be low and the waves calm.
-In the name of the Anchor.
-We shall see where the loyalties of Stormwind truly lie.

  -Pissed**
-Do you know who you are speaking with?

quotes:
-Gossip**
In the ashes of our once-proud kingdom, we find ourselves, hollow and scarred by the betrayals that have stripped us of everything.

Yet, in this desolation, a bitter resolve takes root, for we stand not as defeated remnants but as a united force, forged anew with a singular purpose. The future, once dictated by the whims of the traitorous prince, now lies open before us, a blank canvas upon which we can inscribe our own destiny.

quotes:
### Gossip
In our people's most trying times, it was my unwavering commitment that brought us together to forge this sanctuary of hope. Through earnest efforts, I mended the bonds between our kin and the Alliance, restoring the trust that had faltered. I never sought regal titles or aspirations of grandeur, merely recognizing the pressing need for steadfast leadership.

Yet, in the halls of our own kin, where nobility should be defined by honor and foresight, a blindness persists. The noble families, entangled in the webs of influence and wealth, fail to perceive the true nature of our collective journey. Unjustly stripped of the title of Speaker, a position embraced not for personal gain but for the welfare of our people, I stand witness to a disheartening diversion of focus.

Instead of marshalling our resources and collective wisdom to face the pressing challenges that loom before us, we find ourselves mired in needless debates that obscure the clarity of our path forward.

### On-click
  -Greeting**
- Welcome to Alah'Thalas.
- Greetings, friend.
- Quel'Thalas will not be forgotten.
- Have you come to help us?

  -Pissed**
- Is there something wrong?
- I have left my husband behind for my people.
- My people needed me. They have no one else.
- My eldest sister sacrificed herself for us all, and my other sister... is lost to us.
- I am the last of the Windrunners, and I will sacrifice it all for my people to endure.
- What have you sacrificed?

  -Farewell**
- Al'diel sha'lah.
- Goodbye, friend.
- Stay safe.
- Until we meet again.

Time, a precious resource we squander in endless deliberations, is better spent on the singular, unyielding purpose that binds our hearts - we must reclaim Quel'Thalas from the clutches of the Scourge, employing any means necessary to usher our homeland back into our embrace.

quotes:
-Gossip**
Vereesa's ineptitude in rallying Alliance forces to reclaim Quel'Thalas marks the last straw. I refuse to witness our proud race reduced to a puppet state of Stormwind. With our reliance on the Alliance military, we stand exposed to the threats of both the Scourge and the resurgent Amani tribe.

It is only a matter of time until others recognize my rightful claim to leadership. The Sunsworn dynasty shall ascend, and under my rule, we will endure for countless millennia. The era of vulnerability and subservience is over; the domination of the Quel'dorei shall be reestablished, unyielding against external threats.

title: Voren'thal the Scryer
quotes:
In a bygone era, I stood as the closest confidant and advisor to Prince Kael'thas, watching with sorrow as he forsook us, seduced by the malevolent powers of the Legion.

Though I yearn for his return, the wisps of foresight that caress my ancient senses reveal a path fraught with uncertainty.

Hope lingers, but I am no fool. In the absence of our prince, we must face the harsh reality and select a temporary leader to guide our people through these tumultuous times.

title: Farenia Roseheart
quotes:
-Gossip**
Loathe though I am to do this to her, it seems that despite her best efforts Vereesa has not been able to handle her responsibilities on her own. For the good of our people we must look to someone else for leadership.

Sadly, some here cling to the past, hindering our progress. Perhaps the responsibility of the crown is too much for one head in these circumstances, yet reluctance is ever the companion of fear of change.

We must put our people first and cast aside antiquated loyalties to usher in a new, better era.

I wonder, who would you support in this clash?

title: Halduron Brightwing

Once, in the echoes of time that now feels like a distant fantasy, I dreamed of donning the mantle of Ranger-General. A vision painted with the vibrant hues of ambition danced before my eyes. Yet, the years have woven a different tapestry, one marked by the harsh brushstrokes of reality.

The coveted title, once a beacon of achievement, has transformed into a weighty burden resting heavily upon these weathered shoulders of mine.

Welcome to the Gnomeregan Reclamation Facility! I am High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque, King of Gnomeregan.

While we are grateful for the hospitality of the dwarves, the terminal for the Deeprun Tram will no longer suffice as a home for the Gnomish people. Gnomeregan must be reclaimed, and this old factory has been refurbished into new quarters for the Gnomish people to do so. We can use this place as a staging ground to cleanse and reclaim Gnomeregan from the traitorous Lepers.

We will reclaim what is ours... and bring Thermaplugg to justice!

Now, having said that. What can I help you with?

  **In Grommash Hold**
All members of the Horde are equal in my eyes, <name>. We have all suffered many burdens, and if it were not for wisdom and honor, then we would be no better than the Scourge or my people while our blood was tainted by the demon Mannoroth.

It is your duty to aid the Horde and to defend our way of life. But it is also your duty to know when quarter and compassion should be given to friend and foe alike.

It would be wise to explain to you the depths at which our enemies will go to to hide themselves under our noses.

Know this first and foremost: our enemy is the [Shadow Council](Shadow Council). No matter what task I give you, or who I ask you to act against, know that one simple fact.

Many cults exist within the Council, but only to hide its actions against the foolish.

Groups like the [Burning Blade](Burning Blade), the [Argus Wake](Argus Wake), and the [Searing Blade](Searing Blade) are all tools of the Council. Consider them one and the same

quotes:
### Gossip
A question aches at the back of my mind: Has this world truly forgotten me? All that I was-lost, by choice or fate.

Wherever I turn my gaze, I see nothing. Nothing. This New Horde, our people's future, abandoned me. But I will not abandon it.

Many sang my death to bury the past. Yet here I stand, ready to end what remains of Gul'dan's misery. I feel duty, but also jealousy. What sets me apart from Grommash Hellscream? Were his final acts so grand that they erased his past?

I recall when his name was sung as hero, while I was dismissed as an elder. Perhaps it is unbecoming of me to feel this way, but I will not fade. My name will stand among legends-not by death, but by atonement.

The Shadow Council will face the wrath of my clan, my ancestors, and MY MIGHT.

Lok-tar-ogar!

For the Horde!

quotes:
-Gossip**
Watch your step, <race>. We of the Brotherhood of the Light are not as lenient as our brethren when it comes to meting justice to those that would do this world wrong.

Woe unto those that would anger [Korfax](Korfax).

Now if you have no business with me or the other members of the Brotherhood, please leave so that we may continue our meeting.

  > Gossip: What is Redemption armor?

  The armor of Redemption was worn by our most pious knights - armor worthy of the Lightbringer himself!

  Thousands fell in the last war; their vestments stripped from their corpses and taken to the dread citadel of Naxxramas.

  It is said that the death knights of Naxxramas corrupt the Redemption plate mail for their own use.

  Such tragedy...

  -Meeting with the Scarlet envoys**
   **Scarlet Commander Marjhan says:** Your message did reach us, Commander, but by no means is our involvement here sanctioned by the Grand Crusader.
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** Your leader takes residence at the doorstep to Naxxramas. Do you think he does not feel the pressure?
   Commander Eligor Dawnbringer lowers the sound of his voice to a whisper.
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** Even demons are capable of fear...
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** Scourge activity in the Plaguelands has increased ten-fold. We are receiving reports of Scourge attacks from as far away as Kalimdor! Now how do you suppose this has happened? How have the wretched undead done that which was previously thought impossible? Is nowhere safe?
   **Scarlet Commander Marjhan says:** The heathens will be forced to react. [Orc](Orc)s, bull-men...
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** [Tauren](Tauren).
   **Scarlet Commander Marjhan says:** Whatever. The revolting, unkempt [Horde](Horde) filth...
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** You lack tact, Commander. This is not surprising. However, you are right in that the Horde will be forced to act. But not just the Horde. They already come - heroes from across the world.
   **Scarlet Commander Marjhan says:** Too little, too late. The dam has broken. We are a bump in the road at best.
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** So why are you here? What are we to do if there is no hope?
   **Scarlet Commander Marjhan says:** There is always... [Ashbringer](Ashbringer).
   *Eligor rises from his chair.*
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** So this is what you have come for? To try and claim that which is the reason for the Dawn's existence and the Crusade's downfall? You open old wounds with your words, Commander!
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** [The Ashbringer](Alexandros Mograine) is dead and there will never be another like him. [The lesser Mograine](Renault Mograine) is a far cry from the man his father was. You know this, Commander! It was, after all, your own leadership that was responsible for the death of the Scarlet Highlord Mograine.
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** It was your leadership that manipulated a grieving child to try and recover the sword. A child that has grown into a man with nothing but vengeance and hatred in his heart! And for what? You are no closer to the sword now than you were five years ago.
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** Yet you think that recovering Ashbringer will somehow turn the tide of battle? Let me let you in on a little secret, Commander: The power of the Ashbringer came from the man who would wield it... I was there, Commander. I watched him burn legions of undead in righteous fire before he would even unsheathe the blade. Alas, your grasp on history is ... lacking.
   **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** Now be silent and note where you are, lest I inform [Lord Fordring](Tirion Fordring) and his [knights](Knights of the Silver Hand) that you are no longer here on amicable terms. I am certain he would take great pleasure in seeing to your 'atonement.'
   *Eligor sits back down.*

  -Jessica serving food**
  **Jessica Cham

fields.name: Korfax
fields.titles: Champion of the Light,, Brotherhood of the Light
fields.affiliation: Brotherhood of the Light, Argent Dawn
fields.occupation: Champion of the Light of the Brotherhood of the Light

quotes:
-Gossip**
What is the Brotherhood of the Light? Well... We are all members of the Argent Dawn at the core - members of the Argent Dawn that aren't held in check by morals, guilt and useless human emotion. Consider us Scarlet Crusade minus the stupidity, lack of leadership, and blind zealotry.

Don't let the Scarlet Commander tell you otherwise.

And don't let Tyrosus know I said that... It would be a terrible shame if I had to brutally maim him should a brawl break out.

  > Gossip: What is Dreadnaught armor?

  The first suit of Dreadnaught armor was made exclusively for the Scarlet Highlord Mograine. Whilst donning the full suit, the Highlord looked himself to be a demon from the depths of the Nether.

  Aye, 'twas quite a sight to behold as Mograine would wade into a hundred Scourge, Ashbringer held high, and come out on the other side in a cloud of dust and flames - enemies left in ashes beneath his feet.

  > Gossip: Continue please.

  It was not until after his controversial death that the knights and warriors of Lordaeron would wear similarly fashioned suits in honor of their fallen hero. While the death of Mograine was a great victory for Kel'Thuzad, the resulting martrydom would be felt until the end of the war.

  Where one did fall, many would rise...

  > Gossip: Korfax, where can I find Dark Iron scraps?

  Is this a serious question? You really don't know?

  If you are the cowardly sort, afraid to get their hands too dirty, you will find Dark Iron scraps on the creatures in the Burning Steppes and Searing Gorge.

  If you're the bloodthirsty adventuring type, the dungeons of Blackrock Spire and Blackrock Depths hold quite a large supply of the scraps.

fields.affiliation: Brotherhood of the Light, Argent Dawn

fields.foccupation: Watcher of Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian

quotes:
### Gossip about Atiesh
It is said that [Kel'Thuzad](Kel'Thuzad) seeks the legendary Atiesh, greatstaff of the Guardian.

Yes, the very staff once held by [Medivh](Medivh).

> Gossip: What is Atiesh?

Like Kel'Thuzad, I too was once a mage of the [Kirin Tor](Kirin Tor). And like Kel'Thuzad, I seek the legendary Atiesh, greatstaff of the Guardian. Our fates are intertwined as such, <class>.

> Gossip: What Guardian? I don't understand any of this.

Progeny of [Aegwynn](Aegwynn), he that would be the last Guardian of Tirisfal... Medivh.

> Gossip: Please continue.

It is a story of legend and one that I do not have the time nor the inclination to retell. Just know that Medivh was the last of the Guardians. The greatstaff of Atiesh was a focal point of his power and a focal point of corruption.

> Gossip: What corruption?

The corruption of a fallen titan. The corruption of the Destroyer. After all, the staff was forged from the seed of hate. That is, of course, what has brought me here...

> Gossip: Please continue.

After the fall of Karazhan, the Kirin Tor dispatched an assembly of mages to search the tower and seize all items of import... for the purposes of "research." It was then that the fabled staff was discovered and brought back to Dalaran.

> Gossip: Please continue.

What followed were a series of tragic events, leading to the death of every Kirin Tor mage that came into contact with Atiesh.

You see, it was an artifact with sentience. A sentience granted to it by Sargeras...

> Gossip: What?

<Angela nods.>

After the deaths, the Six decided that the best course of action was to seal the staff behind impenetrable barriers of magic and appoint a watcher: A guardian of the staff... I would be that watcher.

> Gossip: This is disturbing. Please continue.

There is not much more to tell. Dalaran was nearly wholly destroyed by Archimonde, the staff lost, presumably shattered by the barrier's fail-safe mechanisms.

There are those that believe the staff to be the cause of Archimonde's reprisal.

> Gossip: Please, tell me more.

After the fall of Dalaran, I took my leave from the Kirin Tor. I spent years watching over Atiesh, only to have my purpose amongst the Kirin Tor taken from me in one fell swoop. I would find the staff, though it might take a lifetime. That is how I came to join the Argent Dawn and why I am here now.

> Gossip: Is there anything else?

I have tracked the various fragments of the staff across this world and in doing so, discovered Kel'Thuzad's plans to reform the staff. He has already collected several of the staff's fragments - which are being held by his most trusted lieutenants.

I cannot emphasize enough the importance of keeping the greatstaff of the Guardian out of Kel'Thuzad's grasp. Frankly, I do not know what the result would be, other than a catastrophe of epic proportion.

### Core of elements
> Gossip: Where can I find core of elements?

Ah, a good question.

If you prefer hunting in the great outdoors, there are elementals here in the Plaguelands, Azshara, Burning Steppes, Felwood, Silithus, Winterspirng, and even Un'goro Crater.

If you are the type that laughs in the face of danger, then perhaps you should visit Dire Maul. I have heart that a great many elemental abberations[sic] exist within its walls. You would also do well in seeking out the elementals employed by the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths.

### Jessica serving food
  **Jessica Chambers says:** Ok, you had the fish platter, Commander. Enjoy!
  **Jessica Chambers says:** Father, you had the bowl of fruit? Right?
  **Commander Eligor Dawnbringer says:** The fish is exquisite, Jessica.
  **Jessica Chambers says:** And for the ladies, roast baby boar. Enjoy!
  **Father Inigo Montoy says:** Is this a mango? Stupendous!
  **Jessica Chambers says:** Please let me know if you need anything else!
  **Scarlet Commander Marjhan says:** Thank you, Jessica.
  **Scarlet Commander Marjhan says:** And might I add, that dress is lovel

quotes:
Well, you've been a much more friendly face to us, not even our own comrades in arms were willing to simply come up and talk.

I though we would be lauded as heroes, or at the least returned to with open arms, and here we are, treated as villains after surviving the expedition to the north on behalf of the crusade. It sickens me to know how many died to bring the fight to the undead just for things to have fallen apart as they have here.

Either way, apologies for my rudeness, I am Captain Haroldson, of the *Embertide* in the Scarlet Fleet, or at least, what is left of it, anyway, after everything that happened with that doomed expedition.

quotes:
### Theramore
  -Gossip**
I welcome you to Theramore, <name>.

I apologize for being abrupt and not having a lot of time to exchange pleasantries, but my city must come first. Too many things threaten our way of life and the sanctity of the Alliance. I must stay ever vigilant against forces outside of our control if I'm to ensure my people remain safe and happy.

Perhaps we'll have more time to speak later.

  -The Missing Diplomat completed**
Hendel is in our custody now, <name>, thanks to you.

Although the questioning goes slowly, I assure you, he will tell us everything he knows.

For now, please be patient. I will contact you immediately if we have need of your assistance.

Until then, please, enjoy Theramore and I invite you to stay for as long as you like within our city's walls as a friend of the Alliance.

### On-click
-Welcome to Theramore. Have you come to help the Alliance?
-All I ever wanted was to study.
-Shh, I'm trying to think here.

### Aggro
-You asked for it.
-I hate resorting to violence!

title: Ingvild Ellerian
quotes:
-Gossip**
Mourning is something all people have in common. No matter how young or old we are, we all end up mourning our dead. Whether they were taken from us too soon or not, it matters little. Our hearts simply cannot bear the ache. I never imagined that I would outlive my own daughter - yet here I am, staring at a statue that barely resembles her.

My Tiffin was no warrior, but she was a kind, tender soul. Some still remember their short-lived queen and come to pay their respects. For that, I am grateful and content. I long to see her face again, her silly smile, her golden hair.

<Ingvild tears up.>

And I could still see her, if only they would allow me entry into Stormwind. I could see my Tiffin in the face of my grandchild, whom I long to see every day. Yet they deny me. That poor boy, alone in the world, with a dead mother and a missing father. If only he knew how much I love him.

### Gossip
Welcome to Northwind. I apologize for the sorry state you find it in. It seems all of these problems come crashing down on me all at once. And on top of it I don't even have enough soldiers to sufficiently protect my subjects. The populace may think neither I nor my brother care all that much, but that couldn't be further from the truth. And yet, all the strength I have left to solve this chaos is bound by the orders of my king.

### On-click
  -Greeting**
- The nobles of Northwind welcome you, traveler.
- Difficult times are ahead.
- I have to measure up to my father's expectations.

  -Farewell**
- Tread carefully out there.

  -Pissed**
- Don't test my patience, commoner!
- Do you seek the pillory?
- I don't remember calling for a jester.

-Gossip**
Have you seen that silver fox from [Stromgarde](Stromgarde (kingdom)) over there? Isn't he just stunning?

<Modera's eyes are sparkling at the sight of [Commander Leder](Commander Leder). Being obviously enchanted by his appearance, she loses her train of thought before quickly regaining composure.>

Oh, excuse me. How rude. I am Caitlyn Modera, daughter of Archmage Modera of the [Council of Six](Council of Six) governing Dalaran. My mother is incredibly busy rebuilding our great city, as you may have heard already, so I am here in her stead representing Dalaran.

title: Mayor Birkton
quotes:
-Gossip**
Dark times are ahead, adventurer. Much of the peace and tranquility that is left in Northwind vanishes with each passing hour. These lands are falling apart and no one seems to care about it. Neither his Lordship nor the King. It falls to me - to the people - to salvage this tragedy that befalls us. Missing people, invading Defias, Blackrocks and Dark Irons, Gnolls running amok, the whole town of Birkhaven in ruins. I have my hands full of problems and none left to grasp at solutions. I implore on your good faith and morals: Please, help the people of Northwind.

quotes:
### Gossip
Accursed low-lifes! I will not stand for such exorbitance in my lands. The moment this farce of a tournament is over, I will execute swift judgement upon them!

### Jousting tournament
Approximately every one and a half hours, Duke Sherwood will announce the contestants for the latest bout of the jousting tournament.

  -Sir [Rudolf of Strom](Rudolf of Strom) against [Sir Reginald of Stormwind](Sir Reginald of Stormwind)**
  On to our next joust! To my left, a stout knight of our kingdom, Sir Reginald! To my right, from the far kingdom of Strom, Sir Rudolf!
  Now, let us determine which knight will bring glory to its homeland!
  Onwards, to victory!
  A clean strike! Sir Rudolf lies on the ground, defeated by the proud Sir Reginald!
  Glory to Sir Reginald, victor of this knightly joust!

  -[Sir Barnabas of Strom](Sir Barnabas of Strom) against [Lumiere of Dalaran](Lumiere of Dalaran)**
  Another joust awaits! A valiant duel between Sir Barnabas of Strom, a gilded veteran of old, and the equally skilled Lumiere of Dalaran!
  Now, let us determine which knight will bring glory to its homeland!
  Onwards, to victory!
  Such elegance! Lumiere effortlessly demonstrated that Dalaran should not be underestimated! A lesson Sir Barnabas felt hands-on!
  A toast to Lumiere of Dalaran, victor of this knightly joust!

  -[The Black Knight](The Black Knight) against Sir [Halfar of Kul Tiras](Halfar of Kul Tiras)**
  Silence, fair citizens, for a special bout is about to happen! Hailing under no flag and bearing no color, the Black Knight steps into the ring! His opponent: the courageous Halfar of Kul Tiras, breaker of tides and storms!
  Now, let us determine which knight will bring glory to its homeland!
  Onwards, to victory!
  What a merciless display! Call for the doctor, I'm sure Sir Halfar sorely needs it! A gruesome reminder of how brutal these tournaments can become!
  The honor goes to the nameless Black Knight, victor of this knightly joust!

  -[Fritz of Kul Tiras](Fritz of Kul Tiras) against [Sir Lorenz of Theramore](Sir Lorenz of Theramore)**
  Now, fair spectators, a duel of monumental weight awaits us. Sir Lorenz of Theramore against the young and upcoming talent of Fritz of Kul Tiras!
  Now, let us determine which knight will bring glory to its homeland!
  Onwards, to victory!
  Incredible! Anyone present here at this tournament can vouch for the emotional investment brought into this duel. In the end, it is Sir Lorenz who shall be praised for this victory!
  Glory to Sir Lorenz of Theramore, victor to this knightly joust!

  -Sir [Ferdinand of Theramore](Ferdinand of Theramore) against Sir [Estanor of Dalaran](Estanor of Dalaran)**
  The next joust begins! To my left, a brave contestant from the sea-faring nation of Theramore, Sir Ferdinand! To my right, a chivalrous mage and his steadfast steed, Estanor of Dalaran!
  Now, let us determine which knight will bring glory to its homeland!
  Onwards, to victory!
  Devastating! The might of Theramore was demonstrated once more on this day! Sir Estanor could not withstand Sir Ferdinand's mighty blow!
  Glory to Sir Ferdinand, victor of this knightly joust!

King's Honor, friend. Please make sure you behave accordingly when walking these halls. We really can't afford any more trouble than we already have.

  > Gossip: *Good lady, just what chaos has befallen these lands?*

  Simply too much. Lord Amberwood has fortified this land formidably before, yet with most of his troops delegated back to Stormwind, our beloved Northwind laid bare for the taking. All we can protect now are the southern forests of Northwind, and even then we're hardly scraping by. I am simply relieved to see my nephew safe and sound within the castle walls. title: Antonio Perelli

fields.name: Antonio Perelli
fields.title: Traveling Salesman
fields.location: Sentinel Hill, Goldshire, Darkshire, Lakeshire and the roads in between.

quotes:
Upon arrival to [Goldshire](Goldshire):
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Come one, come all! Antonio's wares are for sale. I may not return for a great deal of time, so come one, come all.

  Upon arrival to [Goldshire](Goldshire) (alternate)
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Wares for sale! Wares for sale!  come and browse Antonio's wares before I must take my leave, citizens of Goldshire.

  Upon leaving **Goldshire** for [Westfall](Westfall):
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Good bye, Goldshire. I'll be back soon enough-- Perhaps a week's time.

  arriving to [Sentinel Hill](Sentinel Hill):
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Know throughout the lands, Antonio Perelli's goods now for sale near Sentinel Hill! I must move on soon, so make haste.

  leaving **Sentinel Hill** for **Duskwood**:
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Thank you, all. I shall return again in about a week.

   When about to enter Duskwood from Westfall:
-Antonio Perelli lets out a deep sigh.
-**Antonio Perelli says:** I hate this part of my job. Oh, Duskwood, be gentle with poor Antonio.

  Leaving [Darkshire](Darkshire):
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Farewell, citizens of Darkshire. Until next time...

  When entering Redridge from Duskwood:
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Finally, Redridge. A pleasant change from the cold, dark fog of Duskwood.

  When arriving in [Lakeshire](Lakeshire), Redridge he has the following conversation with [Amy Davenport](Amy Davenport)
-**Amy Davenport says:** Hello, Antonio. It's good to see you safely made it here again. let me know if you need anything.
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Items powerful enough to help make the journey through Duskwood, Antonio perelli's goods are now for sale here in Lakeshire.

  when leaving Lakeshire
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Good to see you again, Amy. Be safe, luv. I'm off to Goldshire now.
-**Amy Davenport says:** Take care of yourself, Antonio. I'll see you in another week.

  crossing the river-bridge near [Eastvale Logging Camp](Eastvale Logging Camp):
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Hello, my friends. It is good to see you again. Still keeping our borders free I see. Antonio appreciates your hard work.
-**Stormwind Guard says:** Hello again, Antonio. Thank you again for the hat for my wife. She adored it.
-**Stormwind Guard says:** Be safe, Antonio.
-**Antonio Perelli says:** You're very welcome! I must be on my way... be safe, all of you.
-**Antonio Perelli says:** Oh, I will my friend. I will indeed. You, too, be safe.

title: Sorgan Trustgrip
quotes:
-Gossip**
The history of this region is steeped in tradition, conflict, and prosperity. The Grim Reaches was once a fertile and suitable land for many families and nobles that once lived within the great halls of Grim Batol itself!

Ours is a weathered story, and one of hardship. We have endured, and adapted to face the threats that have continually sought our destruction. Many of those threats are long gone, and yet we still remain, a testament to the willpower of dwarves within Grim Reaches.

title: Historian Sternhand
quotes:
-Gossip**
A fellow historian perhaps? Are you here to learn of the great [Baggoth Ironmantle](Baggoth Ironmantle)? Renowned general and architect of the Grim Reaches? Did you know it was Baggoth himself that helped orchestrate the defense of the first Dragonmaw incursion?

...Maybe you're more interested in the fall of [Stolgaz Keep](Stolgaz Keep) some years ago?

  > Gossip: *Tell me more about the fall of Stolgaz Keep.*

  Stolgaz Keep's destruction lives in the hearts of many dwarves within the Grim Reaches. It is a tale of woe, and one that we tell often to not forget.

  Stolgaz Keep was created some eighty years ago, and used as a fortress to defend the region from any threats that the Grim Reaches could face. It was a place that many visited to taste its more famous 'Stolgaz Ale', a traditional beverage with a sweet and textured flavor!

  A few years ago, the Dragonmaw orcs returned, and with them came conflict. Their efforts focused heavily on Stolgaz Keep, eventually bringing it, and its brave defenders into ruin. Many attempts were made to retake it through the years. Though some of them had made progress, all of them ended in failure. The land is littered in destruction, and now occupied permanently by the Dragonmaw... I would advise avoiding the roads that lead north.

  > Gossip: *Tell me more about Baggoth.*

  Baggoth Ironmantle was the Marshal of Dun Kithas many years ago. He was a renowned architect who built this very hall that we dwell in now!

  When conflict came to Dun Kithas during the first Dragonmaw incursion in the [Second War](Second War), Baggoth himself rose to the task of defending our lands. Baggoth defeated the orcs in many battles, until an orcish arrow felled him during their retreat from Grim Reaches itself.

  While Baggoth may be known for his contributions during the Dragonmaw Incursion. It was the great feats of engineering and construction that he is most known for today. [Baggoth's Rampart](Baggoth's Rampart) and [Baggoth's Wall](Baggoth's Wall) still stand as defenses that we use to this today, just to the northwest of Dun Kithas, a true testament to his ingenuity and skill.

title: Neto the Time Weaver
quotes:
-[Varian Wrynn](Varian Wrynn)**
   **Varian Wrynn:** What is this? I demand to know who you are!
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** My apologies, King Varian. We are protectors of the sacred timelines and are conducting a minor correction in yours. Please step into this portal.
   **Varian Wrynn:** Although I do not understand, I feel compelled to follow your instructions. Do not let this happen again.
   *Varian steps into the portal.*
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Kings can be... difficult.
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Next up...

  -[Tamaala Bloodhoof](Tamaala Bloodhoof)**
   **Tamaala Bloodhoof:** Ancestors watch over me... where am I?
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Greetings honored Tamaala, lifemate of Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof. We are the protectors of the sacred timelines. Please, let us guide you home to your ancestral spirits.
   **Tamaala Bloodhoof:** I shall go where my ancestors command, but beware elf. I sense an evil lurking in this place.
   *Tamaala steps into the portal.*
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Next up...

  -[Thomas Miller](Thomas Miller)**
   **Thomas Miller:** ..freshly baked... What? What just happened?
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Hmmm... I don't recognize this one. Assistant, I think we summoned the wrong human male.
   **Thomas Miller:** BY THE LIGHT, IS THAT A DRAGON? CALL THE GUARDS, HELP!
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Quickly little human! Run into the portal before the terrifying beast gets you!!
   George chuckles.
   *Thomas runs into the portal.*
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Next up...

  -[Kobold Digger](Kobold Digger)**
   The Kobold stares at George.
   **Kobold Digger:** You has candle?
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** A simple Kobold. Funny, this particular Kobold is responsible for stealing a powerful lantern from Lady Sylvanas. The theft of this lantern led to many deaths and branched timelines.
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Come now little Kobold. Your candle is in this portal here.
   **Kobold Digger:** CANDLE!!!
   *The kobold runs into the portal.*
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Next up...

  -[Go'el](Thrall)**
   **Go'el:** [Aedelas](Aedelas Blackmoore)? Where are you? What is this place?
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Welcome young one. This young orc will grow to be the mighty Warchief of the Horde!
   Go'el laughs to himself.
   **Go'el:** You've got a funny energy about you, elf.
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Your shamanistic powers are strong even now. Now into the portal, young warchief.
   *Go'el steps into the portal.*
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Next up...

  -[Gatekeeper Rageroar](Gatekeeper Rageroar)**
   The Timbermaw sniffs the air.
   **Gatekeeper Rageroar:** Where is this...?
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Ah yes. One of those Timbermaw creatures. This one is meant to be the first to resist demonic corruption and lead its tribe to freedom.
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Let's get you to your assigned timeline.
   *Gatekeeper Rageroar steps into the portal.*
   **Neto the Time Weaver:** Next up...

title: Krull Fireblood
quotes:
### Gossip
Since the death of [Grommash Hellscream](Grommash Hellscream), our clan have been scattered around kalimdor, from [Ashenvale](Ashenvale) down to the [Thousand Needles](Thousand Needles).

Nowadays, only the most fierceful leaders of the Warsong Outriders are listened still.

But one day, sooner or later... A new Warchief will arise! We are the ones who built Orgrimmar in a few days. All the citizens witness what have done the real sons of the Horde!

We'll never let some filthy night elves continue their outrageous sabotage.

The War-effort has no end. As long as the eternal nomadry will run the entire Kalimdor.

-Gossip**
Welcome to Kalkor Point. I assume you have many questions about why there are Centaur here in Gilijim.

A long time ago, practically six years now, we set sail from Kalimdor and joined up with the Southsea Pirates. We were hired as mercenaries and fighters, but our leader betrayed us, and kept the gold for himself.

He has gained the name of 'Reaver' for his brutality and his lack of care or compassion for his fellow brothers in arms. The name Kalkor Point comes from the name of our Mercenary Band, and we wear it like an award.

One day we hope to return home to our kin, but that day still seems far off.

title: Sebastian Gallagher

I enjoy looking at the town from my chair. Each day, I would see children playing in the leaf piles, happily dancing around. Nowadays, we've been robbed of that kind of peace. Children are missing or kept inside by paranoid parents. Were I five years younger, I would take my sword and show this young generation what must be done at times like this! Yet, I am cursed with weak legs and a lazy bum of a son—he's probably asleep right now. At least the Light blessed me with better daughters.

<Theresa chuckles.>

Nevertheless, take a look at our other horses here; they are the best steeds in the entire kingdom! Lady Mildenhall's horses are famous amongst the most prestigious knights and nobles of the capital.

title: Sir Hans Dale
quotes:
-Gossip**
<The young noble exhales a frustrated sigh.>

Well hello, fair peasant. Curious that the guards let you inside Amberwood Keep, given Northwind's current... let's say 'precarious' situation. Did you slide them some coin or are you just that charismatic? Alas, here you are, so you might as well entertain me. Auntie Josephine doesn't even let me out of the castle walls and I am getting bored to death reading the same old tomes again and again.

  > Gossip: *You're not like the other nobles around here.*

  Eh, thank you? You probably shouldn't say that to any other Northwind noble, adventurer. Atleast if you value your freedom. To be frank with you, I actually reside in Stormwind most of my time, it just occurred that I was visiting my aunt when all of the chaos around here happened, so I cannot leave until the other nobles get a firm grip on their lands again. I don't know if you met Duke Sherwood or Sir Amberwood at the Jousting Grounds yet, but they're probably more of what you expect Stormwind nobility to be. Eccentric personality, all the aloofness that comes with their rank, a harsh and strict disposition. If you want to rule over the common folk, it's hard not to develop these traits. Luckily my aunt is more of the benevolent type, unless you anger her, I pray for your safety should you ever accomplish that.

  > Gossip: *What's your opinion on the jousting tournament?*

  I do appreciate a good joust between honorable knights, especially with so many esteemed guests present, or so I heard. Why continue with it when your lands are under attack on all fronts eludes me, however. Lord Amberwood is a wise man, I know that much; even more puzzles me his decision to allocate what little troops he has left to the western parts of Northwind. Whatever his reasoning may be, I hope he doesn't jeopardize the safety of his subjects any longer. It is a noble's duty to ensure the safety of the common man!

  > Gossip: *Why is it forbidden for you to leave the keep?*

  A simple reason, really. Or rather, two reasons. First and foremost, I'm a noble. On top of that, my aunt is incredibly paranoid about my safety, even though I can very well fend for myself. With all the brigands and whatnot running around the hills, she ordered the guards to make sure I don't slip out of the keep. I hate being trapped here. I'd rather ride around Northwind on my trusty steed, but instead I have to twiddle my thumbs around here.

title: Servant Becca
quotes:
-Gossip**
So much to do, so little time. Please, don't make a mess while you are here!

title: Rohlof Bergard
quotes:
-Gossip**
Can you feel the essence of this vale? The crimson trees, rolling verdant fields and the crystal clear breeze coursing through the air? Just taking one deep breath fills my spirit with inspiration like no muse ever could! I'm telling you, there is no place like Northwind in the entirety of the Eastern Kingdoms.

title: Gertrud Selind
quotes:
-Gossip**
I regret every single minute of my precious time I'm still spending in this dump! My entourage and I traveled here from my estate in Stormwind past all the horrible dangers in the woods. My goal was to gain influence with his Lordship and acquire a semi-serious footing in the wealthy lands of Northwind. But now my custom fashioned purse with my sigil ring had been stolen from me, even thought I had it on me at all times! To think someone put his revolting fingers on me makes me want to puke.

  > Gossip: *Sounds like you're in need of some assistance.*

  I hate how right you are, peasant. [This letter here](Perfumed Letter (1)) is all I have for clues. I found it instead of my purse in my belongings. Take it and use it to bring me back my purse, now!

  -With [Lady Selind's Purse](Lady Selind's Purse)**

  > Gossip: *Lady Selind, is this your purse?*

  My purse! You've found it; quickly, hand it to me!

  <Lady Selind hastily searches the purse for her sigil ring.>

  NO! It is gone, my ring! That heinous thief, I cannot believe I, the great and unmatched Gertrude Selind, fell victim to a common thug. Oh, the humiliation! I cannot take this, my face is marked with shame and indignity. You, keep this testament of my disgrace and vanish from my sight. The resilience of the Tauren people, those two tribes that settled here so long ago. Frankly, I hadn't expected them to survive here for that long, but I was proven different. An unexpected visitor. I have not much to offer, but please, let me be as hospitable as I can be. My name is Zarazar Sagewind, from the esteemed capital of magic Dalaran. I know that title may be far-fetched, but our architects are making good strides in restoring our great city to its former glory.

Thulio and I journeyed to this coast alongside the Sentinel expedition. Regrettably, they are a bit apprehensive when it comes to those mastering the arcane practices. While they allowed me to accompany them here, they forbade me from resting with them in their base camp. A bit shortsighted, if you ask me, but I am more than capable of fending more myself.

Now then, how may I assist you?

title: Andanil Sunsworn
quotes:
-Gossip**
Truly a disaster, to be sent here by that fool of a cousin of mine. Of all the places one might be assigned, it had to be this - so distant, so very odd.

These lands are strange, yes, but do not mistake my displeasure for weakness. I did not come all this way to fail. Whatever trials await, I will endure them, and I will see my mission done.

  > Gossip: *Tell me your story, Andanil.*

  My venerable cousin, in what he no doubt considers unmatched wisdom, sent us to this forsaken place chasing draenethyst. Promises of abundance. Of answers. Of being remembered as saviors.

  Yes, the crystals are impressive. Potent, refined, useful. They keep our people standing a little longer. They quiet the hunger. But that is all they do. Sustenance. Not salvation. I did not cross half the world to return to Alah'thalas carrying crates of arcane crystals.

  So I pushed further. Against advice. Against caution. Against that quiet voice that suggests restraint.

  > Gossip: *<continue>*

  North of here lies an old Barrow Den. Forgotten. Abandoned. Or so it appeared. The place bled magic. Not wild, not crude, but dense. Ancient. The sort that makes your skin prickle even before a spell is cast.

  Maelion took a sizeable force and went inside. Capable soldiers. Trained arcanists. People I trusted. Then we heard it. An explosion. Not sound alone. A pressure in the air, like the world itself flinched.

  When we reached the den, there was nothing left of them. Not truly. Their bodies remained, but the mana was gone. Drained clean. Empty shells, withered beyond recognition. Worse than the withered back home. Those at least remember who they were. These ones do not remember anything. Not their names. Not their purpose. Not even fear.

  > Gossip: *<continue>*

  They did not leave the den. They still roam it. Searching. Or guarding. I cannot tell which is more unsettling.

  Whatever happened there involved power far beyond draenethyst. Power that can wither a mage in moments. And that is precisely why it matters. If something can do this, so completely and quickly, then it stands to reason that it might do the opposite as well.

  Yes, I know. Theory. Speculation. Desperation, if you prefer honesty. But desperation is where breakthroughs are born.

  I will not return to Alah'thalas empty handed. Not with excuses. Not with crystals anyone could have gathered. Whatever lies within that Barrow Den is the reason we are here. I can feel it.

  And I intend to claim it, whatever the cost.

- [quest: Expedition Gone Wrong] 
- [quest: The Withered Den]

<Kallion laughs hysterically.>

Don't believe a word of it. They don't care for withered kin like us. All they offer is a sliver of hope, just enough to keep us crawling forward.

title: Pysan the Righteous
quotes:
-Gossip**
I am the great Pysan!

Known far and wide as the Righteous to my allies, and the Vengeant to my enemies! I have battled dragons atop mountains, rescued maidens from towers both high and precarious, and struck down evildoers too numerous to count!

I have faced the dreaded hydra Trioch and lived to tell the tale, ventured into the darkest depths of Maraudon, and brought justice to the wicked lurking in Razorfen Downs!

Tales of my deeds spread far and wide, sung by bards in every tavern and hall!

And yet... ahem... despite all this glory, I must ask - have you, by some miracle, happened to see my sword anywhere?

title: Dhom
quotes:

My tools are both practical and durable! Come and be impressed by Draenei craftsmanship!

title: Z'ahk
quotes:

We've tamed a few of these birds, they are mighty and awe-inspiring creatures that can carry a great amount of weight. Still, they are stubborn and won't let us Draenei ride on their backs. Perhaps you have more luck?

title: Moro'gai Defender

  -Fallen Ones attack Moro'gai Village**
  **Moro'gai Defender yells:** Wretched beast! You will not disturb the peace!
  **Moro'gai Defender yells:** Begone! You do not belong here!

title: Huntress Fan Dhe'ra
quotes:
-Gossip**
Hunting along the coast has become increasingly more difficult. Now with the Fallen Ones roaming about, there is rarely any real opportunity to hunt. Still that fool Tooru was adamant on going out... So much recklessness and potential in that kid, it is honestly a headache trying to mentor him. I wonder how Nar'lan does it. He seems to be a natural when it comes to the youthful Tooru.

  -After [quest: Wolf in Sheep's Clothing]**
  > Gossip: *Tooru has become one of the Fallen Ones. He tortured Nar'lan and paid with his life for it.*

  <Fan Dhe'ra has a solemn expression on her face. Her gaze wanders off into the distance, floating above the azure horizon.>

  I thank you for telling me that. Tooru was a troublemaker, but he was ambitious. He saw something more in this new world than some of the older hunters of the tribe. I reckon his youth played a big part in that. Yet ambitions and foolishness often go hand in hand, regrettably. And his fate is proof of that.
quests: - [quest: The Long Hunt]

title: Bharash
quotes:
-Gossip**
My brother Eka'ghar joined Elder Bhu'robi in his delusion. He has always been gullible, but to think he'd abandon us all so easily... Father would have been deeply ashamed if he was still with us.

  -After [quest: Hooves and Horns, Clad in Red]**
  > Gossip: *Eka'ghar is dead. He and the Fallen Ones coincided with the demons known as Satyrs.*

  With demons, you say?

  <A short and nervous snicker escapes Bharash.>

  Sounds like the fool learned nothing. Hundreds of years of pain and misery and this is how he honors his people, his father? By bowing to the same fiends that massacred us all?! Begone, Parash'ka. I am grateful you have informed me of this, but I wish to be alone now.

title: Ki'nia
quotes:

Draenei history is carved into tablets, cementing them into the annals of time for all eternity. Many of our stories and folklore had been lost following the destruction of our home Draenor, which is why it is all the more important for me to archive the history of our people onto these stone tablets. It is a responsibility I shoulder with great pride.

I have to say, these Draenei sure know how to cook some spicy food. Not as spicy as the stew we had in the Harborage, must've been because of those swamp herbs. My companions would surely agree. Except Olgra, that woman is always trying to one-up me. But that's what makes her so endearing, even if I'd never tell her that directly. And I hope you won't either.

title: Botanist Nepkal

-Gossip**
I am tending to the flora growing on this island we have settled on. Ever since the tribe drifted here from beyond the Twisting Nether, the plants have steadily worsened over time. The elders and I assume the draenethyst residue that seeped into the soil to be the source of the stress they are suffering from. A regrettable consequence. We have damaged the coast with our arrival and therefore it is our obligation to care for it in turn.

My trade is the jewelcrafting, and I have learned under the best tutor there is. If you are interested in some supplies, I am more than eager to strike a deal with you.

title: Tobuuri

-Gossip**
I am tending to the birds of these lands, whom we have been told are called plainstriders. They are an ornery kind, and often stubborn, but patience with them is rewarded. Both their strength and resilience reminds us of the ones from our homeworld. We called them Narak'la, which means Starglider in your tongue. They were elusive birds, slick feathers and meaty legs, soaring through the starlit skies of Draenor.

Caring for these plainstriders reminds me of home; usually a painful memory, it is a rare form of solace for me.

title: Elder Krasheen
quotes:
-Gossip**
Weaving arcane energy requires great amounts of focus. Those who easily falter under its pressure are either torn apart or driven mad. I've seen it countless times with naive acolytes of my people's tribes. Tell me, is your kind resilient enough to withstand the sheer energy of the Twisting Nether? I am more than curious.

title: Riftmaster Ral'pekta
quotes:
-Gossip**
Among the Draenei there is nothing more sacred than the venerable art of Riftwalking. Once a widely spread practice, it is now sadly nothing more than an empty shell of the grandeur us Riftwalkers were able to conjure in age-old times; eons ago, under the swirling firmament of Draenor's night sky. I fear your kind may not grasp the magnitude of this sorcery, judging from your befuddled look. No need to trouble yourself with foolish contemplations. Riftwalking is a sacred rite, it will not be sullied by you lesser races, even in its current, pitiful state. The weaving of the arcane fabric itself, drawing power from the hallowed Draenethyst; only us Draenei shall possess this power, and no one else.

Nevertheless, danger and uncertainty plague my people's minds, as sinister forces have begun encroaching, threatening our dream of a new home. If your wish for tranquility resonates with ours, then please: Aid me and my people survive these new risks.

title: Heghala
quotes:
-Gossip**
Greetings, wanderer from afar. Us Draenei revere the sacred Draenethyst, a pure crystal formed from the lifeblood of our homeworld Draenor. When our tribe fled to this place with our ancient Riftwalk magic, residue energy of the process seeped into the ground of your own world. Over time, the once foreign crystals began forming on their own.

With the ever more swiftly encroaching darkness across these plains, we are barely able to harvest more of the precious Draenethyst. The village is dependent on these gems, as they bear great amounts of power, both spiritually and magically. If you find them during your travels through the coast, don't hesitate to bring them to me. I will award you with our finest treasures should you do so.

The dryads will aid him with all their might! The protectors of nature will stand strong and united against the evil of this world.

fields.location: Grove of the Sun, Moonwhisper Coast

Not many of us are left. This grove used to be full of druids in harmony with the wilds, even despite Tyrandas having long been abandoned. Now those same druids wage war against their own kind. What could drive them to such madness?

title: Achak Pinemoon

fields.name: Achak Pinemoon
fields.location: Grove of the Sun, Moonwhisper Coast

quotes:
-Gossip**
Within the groves of Moonwhisper Coast, we were all disciples of Cenarius, practitioners of his teachings and fellow scholars of nature's splendor. No matter if Night Elf or Tauren, under the guidance of Malorne's son, we were one. My heart weighs heavily dreading these days to soon be over.

title: Naturalist Pinemoon

fields.name: Naturalist Pinemoon
fields.location: Grove of the Sun, Moonwhisper Coast

quotes:

My brother Achak and I have many friends in the Grove of the Moon on the mainland. The possibility of them being among the invaders defiling the ruins of Tyrandas is both revolting and saddening.

title: Elder Moonhoof
quotes:
-Gossip**
The omens are clear, traveler. The eyes and tear of the Earthmother still bless our skies during the eternal cycle of night and day. And yet, they have grown distant from each other, much like our people. A time has come when sibling will fight sibling, when the very blood that unites us will be shed across the blue grass of our coast. It is a heavy cost and an even heavier burden. A future we need not know, but will.

title: Nuhlgahn Windhorn
quotes:
-Gossip**
I come from the great lands of Thousand Needles. My outcast tribe has been searching for a new place to call home. We widely regard our Moonhoof brothers and sisters as cousins, so I see no better place to build a new life.
quests:
- [quest: The Windhorn Burden] 
- [quest: In Lucid Dreams]

title: Tagasha Windhorn
quotes:
-Gossip**
I have heard many stories about our Moonhoof cousins from home at Windhorn Canyon. Exaggerated tales of how they could dance in the stars and bask in the great offerings of the blue child.

<Tagasha lets out a small laugh.>

It is funny how these small tales can be so quickly spiralled into myth.

title: Dhela
quotes:
-Gossip**
Stray not too far from our village, young one. The coast has become far more dangerous now than it ever was, now more than ever, when those we once called brethren choose to bask in the light of Lo'sho under a different name. Beware the shades and those who see themselves as Shadewalkers, for while they sing the name of Lo'sho in joy, they seek it for chaos and destruction.
quests: - [quest: Lady Stargazer]

title: Lotka Muddoll
quotes:
-Gossip**
Do not listen to that foolish Uz'tuk. He favors the air elementals. Hmph. A weakling who used to cower in the sand. Yet he is strong in a fight, even when lurking in the shadows. He may be the best companion I have had since joining the Earthen Ring. Apart from Muddoll, of course.

Behold, a true elemental. The earth shakes as it moves. The stone breaks in its wake. Truly the embodiment of the orcish desire for both strength and honor. No element is more sturdy, more beautiful, than the very earth you walk on.

<Lotka clears her throat.>

I may have gotten carried away there. You saw nothing.
quests: - [quest: Bound in Stone]

title: Primalist Palaz
quests: -  [52] [Bengal Fangs](Bengal Fangs)

title: Uz'tuk
quotes:
-Gossip**
The Earthen Ring has come to investigate the turbulent behavior of the local elementals. They are far too restless here. Blessed be the Loa, it keeps me away from the sand and dust for a while. As a sand troll, ever since our [Sandmoon Village](Sandmoon Village) joined the Horde, fleeing Tanaris was my greatest dream. Imagine my surprise when I reached Durotar and traded sand for dust. Even the Earthen Ring keeps its circle in Stonetalon. When all this is done, I might even ask the Moonhoof Tribe to let me stay.
quests:
- [quest: What Upsets the Elements?] 
- [quest: In Need of Water] 
- [quest: In Water, Clarity]

title: Matron Mefini
quotes:
-Gossip**
I am worried, <Class>. The Youngbloods grow up in a time of turmoil and uncertainty. We lived in harmony for many moons in our humble village, minding our own business and keeping mostly to ourselves. Seeing what dangers roam outside our walls, and at what alarming speed they spread across the coast, I fear for the survival of our tribe. Just what are we to make of this fate? The Earthmother must be testing our resolve, it must be.

title: Innkeeper Warmbreeze
quotes:
-Gossip**
Rest, weary soul, you who are burdened by adventure and whose shoulders carry the weight of mountains when required. Let the incense I burn fill your nostrils and ease your stiff, tense body. Allow each of your muscles to loosen, each of your bones to crack in relief. Rest. Tomorrow brings another day.

title: Parnal
quotes:
-Gossip**
The Moonhoof tribe has gained our name from the ancient texts that describe how our great mother once walked with the moons. It is our legacy to uphold these lands, and keep them sacred.

title: Fisher Ghujabi
quotes:
-Gossip**
I traveled here from [Revantusk Village](Revantusk Village), far far to the east in the [Hinterlands](Hinterlands). Chatty adventurers like yourself told me of this azure coast where the fish are as beautiful as they are big. Naturally I got eager to prove to my tribesmen that the great Ghujabi can fish any fish, be it at home or in the far reaches of the world. They'll be singing songs about me when I return!

title: Fisher Rainstrider
quotes:
-Gossip**
Fish under the light of the two moons, and you may one day catch the mythical White-Scaled Eel.
quests:
- [quest: Siren's Song] 
- [quest: Taste for Hydra]

title: Duln Ashtotem
quotes:
-Gossip**
To think the Moonhoof chief would turn me away, and yet allow those foolish Windhorns an audience. The Matron will be heavily displeased. At least not all ears have shut themselves from our whispers.
quests:
- [quest: Heart Full of Shadows] 
- [quest: Gifting the Matron]

title: Mhulf Nighthorn
quotes:
-Gossip**
Several spirits haunt the Moonwhisper Coast, young one. While some of our ancestors have been disturbed, these hungering, cold, vengeful spirits are of elven nature. I thank the Earthmother that it was my eyes she took, for had she not, I would be forced to gaze upon the night sky and turn my sight away from Mu'sha, just as she has turned away from our need for aid. Why she allows these vile spirits to torment us, I do not know, for she chooses not to answer.

Thankfully, she is not the only one I rely upon. When the pale one turns its light away from us, the blue draws ever closer. If you find yourself in trouble upon our lands, look to the sky for Lo'sho, young one. He will listen, when others will not.
quests:
- [quest: Highborne Burden] 
- [quest: Youngest Sibling, Always Last] 
- [quest: race=tauren|class=priest]

title: Moonhoof the Younger
quotes:
-Gossip**
The tribe is in great peril, and yet my father turns a blind eye to it. He has grown stubborn, obsessed even. He sees nothing but An'she. He looks nowhere but to the sky, whether by day when its light burns or by night when it shines through Mu'sha. He is so fixed in his belief that he will not listen to reason. The people, our people, those who left the village, did so out of fear and neglect.

It pains me to speak ill of my own parent. Earthmother hold me, I can no longer stand by and simply watch. I will not shed the blood of my kin over a dispute of absent idols.

You are an outsider here, and so I ask you to listen not only to my frustration. Be a friend to me in this time of need, and I will never forget the debt I owe you.
quests:
- [quest: Mindless Monster] 
- [quest: One Heir to Another] 
- [quest: Bloodhoof Stands with Moonhoof] 
- [quest: Facing the Elder] 
- [quest: Seeking the Truth] 
- [quest: Moondancer Lives?] 
- [quest: Mothshroud Falls] 
- [quest: Moonhoof Rests]

title: Brave Wildheart
quotes:
-Gossip**
I am charged to secure Moonhoof Village from threats that encroach upon our borders. Though it seems as of recently I have become a babysitter tasked with keeping the peace.

There have been a few squabbles which I have had to sort through, so please do not add fuel to the fire.
quests: - [quest: Report to Moonhoof Village]

title: Thobias Shallowgrave
quotes:
-Gossip**
Several odd crystals have been sighted around these lands. One of the Moonhoof tribesmen reported this in Thunder Bluff, and it seems the Royal Apothecary finds it rather interesting. I was tasked with the research, which is, frankly, probably the worse idea possible. I am no fighter, I have never held a weapon in my life. And while I have all the time I need to study these crystals, I fear they will turn to dust long before anyone makes a proper fighter out of me.

You look like the adventuring type. Why not help me?
quests:
- [quest: Collecting Draenethyst] 
- [quest: Collectors of Draenethyst] 
- [quest: Actual Collector of Draenethyst]

title: Ulf Stonetotem
quotes:
-Gossip**
With each passing day, I miss my younger brother more and more. Yet while I chose the path of the hammer to craft for our tribe, his was a different one. He left home for Bloodhoof Village, where he would one day become a great warrior. As much as I miss him, I dream of the day he returns, a man with a fulfilled goal.
quests:
- [quest: The Mighty Elekk] 
- [quest: Brother's Duty]

title: Zegh Sparkleblast
quotes:
-Gossip**
I have travelled all the way from Sparkwater Port to offer my help to this tribe, and yet they refused to allow me entry into their village. Thankfully, this elder allowed me to rest in his hut. Perhaps he took pity on me, since he too feels like an outsider among them.

title: Luhal Tannedhorn
quotes:
-Gossip**
Another outsider. Come, rest under my roof. I hope you do not mind company. This goblin and his odd companion were refused entry, and so they too were in need of rest.

-Gossip**
The Moonhoof used to partake in a sacred hunt along this coast. The kodos' hides were used to craft ceremonial drums and their meat offered sustenance for many days to come. But now that these alien parasites run rampant, we cannot uphold our own traditions anymore.

title: Torgan the Wise
quotes:
-Gossip**
Ah, a new sheep looks to join our flock? Many have already begun to gather here for the coming ceremony, and many others have come to find shelter from the wolves at our doorstep.

It would appear this dawning of the Blue Child has certainly come at an opportune time.

<Bulrok gazes upon you, as if this name is supposed to garner respect.>

Bah, you do not know the name? You're much like the others, ignorant, and blind to our history. My tribe once held control over the Thousand Needles long ago and exerted influence over the Tauren.

<Bulrok scoffs arrogantly, raising his chin at this affront.>

title: Elder Starstrider
quotes:
-Gossip**
Why hello there young one, I am Elder Starstrider. I am the one who looks after our most sacred rituals and ceremonies, and have been entrusted to our traditions.

Already many have begun to migrate here in anticipation for the celebration of the Blue Child's return. It is said that the return of the Blue Child is to herald a new chapter in our tribe's vaunted history.

Whatever the Blue Child's return may mean, it is a special occasion, one that warrants celebration, and ritual to honor our ancestors.

title: Ornak Starstrider
quotes:
-Gossip**
We must be the light in the darkness, to guide those who cannot find the path of redemption. It is up to us loyal priests to keep the unity of the Tauren.

There are many perils in this world and corruption towards darkness can be found from the most unlikely places. Many look to us for direction, and we must point them on the familiar path, the one trodden by our ancestors before us.

Spirituality and tradition are hand in hand, bound in unison. We cannot exist without one, just as we cannot exist without eachother.

-Gossip**
[Mort](Mort Gallspewer) has spent too much time outside of Undercity again. The sight of fresh Scarlet corpses excites him to no end, as you can clearly see. I can help you prevent ending up like him. Bracing yourself against the dangers of Lordaeron is a skill the Dark Lady expects all of us to possess.

-Gossip**
<Mort is giggling at the sight of you. Occasional twitching of his head and body complete his deranged look.>

Interested in some materials? Yes, yes! Of course you are, come closer, I won't bite...

title: Sagh
quotes:
-Gossip**
When I was young a group of centaur slaughtered my family during one of our caravan runs. It was the Windhorn Tribe that rescued me, and adopted me. I am forever in their debt and consider Windhorn Canyon home. It burns at my heart to know that the Grimtotem now reside there.
quests: - [quest: Relics of the Windhorn Tribe]

title: Malgan Windhorn
quotes:
-Gossip**
The Windhorn have nearly been eradicated, our home has been stolen from us, and now we are left to wander, as refugees and nomads.

I have returned to this familiar place in search of vengeance. Though this is not something I can do alone... Will you be the hand of my wrath?
quests: - [quest: The Wrath of Malgan]

title: Brolan Windhorn
quotes:
-Gossip**
My family has long lived within the Thousand Needles. It is our ancestral home, and a place that we have walked for what seems to be countless generations. Now all of our lives have been upended, and we find ourselves nothing more than refugees.

  *What happened to make you refugees?*

  The Blackwind is what happened. A vile group of Grimtotem murderers and savages led by one named 'Shalk' who is their chieftain. They invaded our sacred home, Windhorn Canyon almost a month ago.

  The devastation they brought was horrid, so many innocents were slain in their bloodlust and conquest. Now my tribe has been left to wander, to find a new place to call home... Atleast what is left of us.
quests: - [quest: The Need to Survive]

title: Ruhit Windhorn
quotes:
-Gossip**
The Blackwind are lucky that I was not present during their great conquest of my home. It burns me with anger to know that I was away on a hunt while they stormed and murdered my friends, and family.

title: Aganna Windhorn
quotes:
-Gossip**
Malgan has grown to have spite in his heart. No matter what I do it would appear his mind has been set. I do not blame him, for we have had nearly everything stolen from us. I am only here to make sure he does not end up killed.

title: Brakan
quotes:
-Gossip**
We have not survived the deadly heat of Durotar by sheer luck. Our people are resilient, but moreso, they are resourceful. You ought to hone your instincts and skill, otherwise you'll not make it for long out there.

title: Rishu

For many years we have traveled across the lands of Kalimdor, persecuted by the centaur marauders. During that time, we learned much from the land, its dangers and its intransigence. If you wish to survive, you have to fight tooth and nail for it, as there is no mercy for you out there.

My sister tend to the wounds, teaching First Aid and I'm certain that healing comes from the Earth-Mother much more than any bandage could ever heal, gifts of the Earth itself.

Growing food is an art I'm eager to know as good as my own hooves.

Now come, young one. Let me show you the wonders of the dark arts.

title: Hulfnar Stonetotem
quotes:
-Gossip**
Rigorous training builds muscle, tenacity and stamina. It we want to protect our sacred Mulgore, we need to stay strong - no, become even stronger!

  -Fight with Thontek**
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] Hulfnar! Thontek! Stand and address me.
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] I want you both to demonstrate the techniques I have taught you for the benefit of the younger students here. Ready... begin!
  **Hulfnar Stonetotem says:** [Taurahe] Start running!
  **Thontek Rumblehoof says:** [Taurahe] Do not push me, or I will impale you on my horns!
  **Hulfnar Stonetotem says:** [Taurahe] Bring it on!
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] Enough talk you two! Commence fighting!
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] Now that's a War Stomp! Good job!
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] That's how it's done class! You better be paying attention!
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] Ish nu! That's enough!
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] Good, good. Now bow to each other.
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] Now bow to me.
  **Krang Stonehoof says:** [Taurahe] Good job you two. Now go have a seat.
quests: - [quest: Brother's Duty]

title: Lord Nazgrim Redbrand
quotes:
-Gossip**
My name is Nazgrim Redbrand, Lord of the noble Redbrand family. The Redbrands have suffered many tragedies of late, with our namesake crumbling around us. I will not stand idly by and watch my family's legacy tarnished by misfortune.

The reputation of a dwarf means a great deal here in Khaz Modan, and so long as I stand as the head of the Redbrand family, I shall see its honor restored.
quests:
- [quest: Ore Must Flow] 
- [quest: Ore Must Flow]

title: Torwyn Redbrand
quotes:
-Gossip**
Ours is a rich history, full of distinction and honor. We once served as the right hand to the Bronzebeards, but there have been many unfortunate incidents within the past few generations.

I have been looking for assistance in collecting a number of our lost chronicles. Perhaps you could be of help?
quests:
- [quest: The Redbrand Archive] 
- [quest: The Redbrand Lie]

title: Torlig Redbrand
quotes:
-Gossip**
We Redbrand fought alongside the king in the War of Three Hammers ages ago. We hold a proud legacy and should not be judged lightly.

title: Gimle Redbrand
quotes:
-Gossip**
I wouldn't mess with the Redbrand if I were ye.

title: Belwyth Redbrand

I suggest you do not cross them, <Class>.

title: Magna Runecleave

-Gossip**
I am solemnly sworn to defend the interests of my lord.

title: Darrak Redbrand
quotes:
-Gossip**
There is always adventure to be had, especially out in the far frontiers.

title: Lead Explorer Whitepeak
quotes:
-Gossip**
Welcome to Bael Hardul, this place was left here from the time of the Third War.

Us dwarves contributed to help the Alliance during those times, battling against orc and demon alike until the unification and the battle at Mount Hyjal.

This place was left abandoned, we've only just recently arrived to call it home for our future expedition.

We could certainly use the help if you're willing to offer assistance.
quests:
- [quest: Dwarves of Bael Hardul] 
- [quest: Exploring in Peace]

title: Engineer Tansi Sparkfuse
quotes:
-Gossip**
The life of an engineer, I thought I would be doing invention, but I mostly am a glorified mechanic helping fix broken devices and machinery.

Oh well, atleast I'm working with tools.
quests:

- [quest: The Fixed Sputtervalve Conductor]

title: Harlek Vaultshield
quotes:
-Gossip**
The skies be calling my name but I can't be answering!

The bloody flying machine went and broke down, and now I'm grounded like the rest of the peasantry.

You know a thing about Gyrocranked Fizz-wobbled engines?
quests:
- [quest: The Sputtervalve Conductor] 
- [quest: The Sputtervalve Fix] 
- [quest: The Fixed Sputtervalve Conductor]

- [quest: Gorras Thorncrusher]

<The dwarf is visibly upset.>

All that preparation just for some vultures to come and ruin everything.
quests: - [quest: Salvaging the Crops]

-Gossip**

I'm certain he could use my experience and expertise out here, especially so far from home.
quests:

- [quest: The Battlebeard Legacy]

quotes:
-Gossip**

title: Orrik Thunderbeard

The skies of Kalimdor are as untamed as its lands. Where would you like to fly to?

title: Prospector Flinthammer

Kalimdor is surely to be full of rich and rare minerals that we don't often see on the Eastern Kingdoms and I'm sure of it. I just need to find what I'm looking for, that's all.
